title: Concept: ISO 20022 payment message in a response
description: An ISO 20022 document with its namespace and payment fields in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The document contains the debtor and creditor accounts with the settlement amount, which is the full instruction a payment processor would act on.
